policy: Labels describe a recorded voice only. ViNT never infers a user's accent, region, gender or ethnicity and never chooses a voice from them.
No voice is cloned from an identifiable person without their written permission.
A profile may be 'available' only if its model files are installable, its license is verified and attribution is recorded.
Regional Nigerian Pidgin styles stay 'unavailable' until consented data and an evaluated model exist.

profiles.accent_description: British English, northern. A recorded UK speaker. NOT a Nigerian accent and not trained on Nigerian Pidgin.
profiles.status_reason: Installable. Text is pronounced with English rules, so Pidgin words may sound wrong. No listener evaluation has been done.
profiles.license: CC-BY-SA-4.0 (dataset license stated in the model card)
profiles.attribution: Piper VITS voice 'northern_english_male' (medium), trained on data from OpenSLR resource 83 (http://www.openslr.org/83/), CC BY-SA 4.0; packaged by the sherpa-onnx project.
